```artifact
TC-001: System accessible in supported browsers
  Precondition: System is deployed at the Padmavathi hospital website URL.
  Steps:
    - Launch Safari browser and navigate to the Padmavathi hospital website URL.
    - Verify system loads without errors.
    - Launch Chrome browser and navigate to the Padmavathi hospital website URL.
    - Verify system loads without errors.
    - Launch Firefox browser and navigate to the Padmavathi hospital website URL.
    - Verify system loads without errors.
  Expected: System loads without errors in all three browsers.

TC-002: System not accessible in unsupported browser
  Precondition: System is deployed at the Padmavathi hospital website URL.
  Steps:
    - Launch Internet Explorer browser and navigate to the Padmavathi hospital website URL.
    - Verify system does not load (main page not displayed).
  Expected: System does not load.

TC-003: System uses secure connection (https)
  Precondition: System is deployed at the Padmavathi hospital website URL.
  Steps:
    - Navigate to the Padmavathi hospital website URL using https://.
    - Verify connection is secure (browser shows padlock icon).
  Expected: Connection is secure.

TC-004: System enforces https (redirects from http)
  Precondition: System is deployed at the Padmavathi hospital website URL.
  Steps:
    - Navigate to the Padmavathi hospital website URL using http://.
    - Verify system redirects to https:// or connection is secure.
  Expected: System redirects to https:// or connection is secure.

TC-005: Prescription and invoice sent via email after consultation
  Precondition:
    - Patient with valid email address is registered.
    - Consultation completed.
  Steps:
    - After consultation, check email system for email containing prescription and invoice.
  Expected: Email containing prescription and invoice received at patient's email address.

TC-006: No email sent if patient email missing
  Precondition:
    - Patient without email address specified.
    - Consultation completed.
  Steps:
    - After consultation, check email system for email to patient.
  Expected: No email sent.
```
